title: System-One RSI: Building Muscle Memory for Interactive Agents through Guided Practice
title_zh: System-One RSI：通过引导式练习为交互智能体建立肌肉记忆
abstract_en: Reasoning models provide strong multimodal task understanding but struggle with sub-second control because deliberation increases decision latency. Fast decision models can meet the response window, yet prompting and few-shot examples do not readily provide the fine-grained experience required by a new task. Inspired by coached motor learning, this paper presents System-One Recursive Self-Improvement (System-One RSI), which couples two loops. The high-frequency online inner loop is an Observe, Orient, Decide, Act (OODA) cycle: a decision model maps each visual observation and task question to structured judgments, and a decision tree converts them into timed actions without invoking a reasoning model. The offline outer loop is a recursive improvement cycle carried out by a team of reasoning agents. The team revises the decision-model prompt and decision tree, captures interaction records, derives supervision from those records, and trains or deploys updated model parameters. The improved system then returns to the environment and generates the experience for the next round, consolidating learned distinctions as external muscle memory. The framework operates with a small number of real episodes, without expert demonstrations, environment modification, sandboxing, or parallel simulation. Experiments in Snake, Zenless Zone Zero, and Black Myth: Wukong use a 27B decision model. Mean Snake score increases from 1.30 to 7.35. In an evaluated scenario of Zenless Zone Zero, median completion time decreases by 8.4%. In an evaluated combat scenario of Black Myth: Wukong, the evasive policy achieves 11 times the mean survival time of a stationary reference, while the offensive policy win rate rises from 0% to 66.7% across the evaluated configurations.
abstract_zh: 推理模型擅长理解多模态任务，但长时间推理难以满足亚秒级控制的要求；快速决策模型虽能及时响应，却难以仅凭提示和少样本示例掌握新任务所需的细粒度经验。受教练指导下的运动技能学习启发，论文提出 System-One Recursive Self-Improvement（System-One RSI），将高频在线控制与离线递归改进结合起来。在线内环采用 OODA（Observe, Orient, Decide, Act）循环：决策模型根据视觉观测和任务问题生成结构化判断，再由决策树将判断转化为按时序执行的动作，全程不调用推理模型。离线外环由多个推理智能体协作，修订决策模型的提示词和决策树，从交互记录中提取监督信号，并训练模型或部署更新后的参数。改进后的系统重新进入环境，为下一轮迭代积累经验，将习得的细粒度判断固化为外部“肌肉记忆”。该框架仅需少量实际交互回合，无需专家演示、环境改造、沙箱或并行仿真。采用 27B 决策模型的实验显示：Snake 的平均得分从 1.30 升至 7.35；Zenless Zone Zero 在受评测场景中的通关时间中位数缩短 8.4%；Black Myth: Wukong 在受评测战斗场景中，闪避策略的平均存活时间达到静止基线的 11 倍，进攻策略在所评测配置中的胜率从 0% 提升至 66.7%。
key_points_zh: 在线 OODA 内环将感知判断与动作执行分开：27B 决策模型输出结构化判断，决策树负责动作时序，无需在线调用推理模型。
离线外环从交互记录中提取监督信号，结合提示词、决策树和模型参数的更新，逐轮改进策略。
框架仅需少量实际交互回合，不依赖专家演示、环境改造、沙箱或并行仿真。
在受评测任务中，Snake 平均得分从 1.30 升至 7.35，Zenless Zone Zero 通关时间中位数缩短 8.4%。
在 Black Myth: Wukong 的受评测战斗场景中，闪避策略平均存活时间为静止基线的 11 倍，进攻策略胜率从 0% 升至 66.7%。
